verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web scraping and crawling API, so an anti-bot or stealth browser mode is a fair question for this product. The evidence covers browser actions, screenshots and crawling, but nothing documents an undetected or stealth browser mode, fingerprint evasion, or bot-detection bypass. Community posts only ask whether it uses residential or rotating proxies; they are open questions, not evidence the capability exists or fails.
